svg.aria-label: Who I am, what I build, how it should feel, and what I do off the keyboard

g.text: Hey, I'm Shahruk. I've been building for the web for about ten years, mostly for small businesses in the
US and UK: contractors, clinics, coaches and online stores. I write my own themes and plugins instead of
stacking page builders, so the sites stay fast and the code stays mine to fix.
// Headless WordPress. Editors keep the WordPress they know. The front end is Next.js, fed by WPGraphQL.
// Shopify apps. Custom apps and theme extensions with Remix, Polaris and the Admin GraphQL API.
// An AI sales assistant. My own product. It answers visitors from a company's own content, spots the
real leads and books the call.
Scroll that doesn't stutter. Headlines that land with a bit of weight. Hover states that feel
considered. Most of that is GSAP and Lenis on top of a clean build, plus a lot of replaying the same
three seconds until the easing is right.
Fishing, travelling, and teaching WordPress and SEO on my YouTube channel, Learn With Shahruk.
